retrievalProfile.description: A dark, monochromatic psychedelic composition featuring a central glowing eye surrounded by a dense spiral of hand-drawn surrealist doodles and cosmic patterns.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast illustration centered on a bright, stylized eye with a detailed iris. The eye is the only light element in a dark, complex field of black-on-dark-grey line art. The background consists of a swirling vortex containing hands, clouds, stars, and abstract shapes, creating a sense of infinite depth and movement.
coreVisualRelationships: Central eye as the primary high-contrast focal point
Spiral composition drawing the eye inward
Dense texture vs. flat negative space
Monochromatic background vs. subtle color in the iris

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The eye is centered and medium-scale, acting as the 'pupil' of the entire composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white sclera of the central eye.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's gaze starts at the bright eye and spirals outward along the textured paths of the background illustration.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, textured areas act as a heavy frame for the central light source.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black for the background and line work.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the eye's sclera.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted purple and orange within the iris detail.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between the eye and the background; very low saturation overall.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, blocky sans-serif and distressed scripts.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters following the curvature of the spiral
Distressed edges to match the doodle style

composition.position: top and bottom of the central eye

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Combine heavy block lettering with thin, scratchy script for a DIY aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rugged, hand-carved feel of the illustration.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark monochromatic illustration of a spiral vortex filled with hand-drawn doodles of hands, clouds, and stars. Place a bright, glowing white eye in the center with a detailed, colorful iris.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-drawn block lettering that follows the curve of the spiral above and below the central eye using a solid black fill.

verificationChecks: Is the eye the brightest point?
Does the background feel dense and textured?
Is the spiral composition clearly visible?
Is the text integrated into the flow of the spiral?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the eye is perfectly centered.
Check that the line art remains sharp and not blurry.
Verify the monochromatic balance is maintained.
Confirm the text follows the spiral path correctly.
